newsitem.title: USA: Equitable Cos unit buys stake in REIT co.
newsitem.headline: Equitable Cos unit buys stake in REIT co.

text.p: Equitable Real Estate Investment Management Inc, a unit of Equitable Cos Inc, said Thursday it acquired the interest held by AMB Institutional Realty Advisors in AMB Rosen Real Estate Securities LLC, an investment management firm specializing in real estate investment trusts or REITs.
The company, which has $170 million in assets under management in real estate securities funds and separate accounts, has been renamed ERE Rosen LLC, Equitable said.
Equitable Real Estate said it owns 50 percent of the firm, with key principals Kenneth Rosen and Michael Torres retaining their interests in the company.
Other terms of the sale were not disclosed.
The acquisition marks Equitable Real Estate's entry into the REIT and real estate securities management business, and signals the company's intention to introduce a real estate mutual fund, it said.
